title: FBI-UAP-D023, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-7, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: A digital rendering — an artistic interpretation image — created by the FBI depicting a reported UAP incident.
interpretation_warnings: No extractable body text — all content is derived from war.gov metadata, not from the image itself.
This is an artistic interpretation, not a photograph or sensor capture; visual details reflect an artist's rendering, not primary evidence.
Single-source account: the underlying incident rests on one federal law enforcement special agent's first-hand description (recorded in DOW-UAP-D080), unverified here.
Location and site identity are deliberately vague ('a sensitive national security site'), so the event cannot be independently pinpointed from this document.
The rendering was produced in 2026, roughly three years after the described 2023 event.
